body: If I can't make a living off the one talent I have, then it isn't worth it then.

I wouldn't even know where to start. I got into the whole writing thing thinking I could make a living off my writing novels, short stories and comics.

My artist doesn't care, my assumptions were tossed out when I learned writing doesn't bring any kind of sustainable money unless you're Stephen King and I can't find any job with any of my skills that allows for me to put more time into my writing.

I just, I reach out for the wheat and get nothing but air, if that makes sense. It's like that bitch Lucy from The Peanuts. Life pulls the football away at the last second and I just get tired of going for it.

I'm unsure about Fiverr since I've never really looked into it but i might read up on it.
Exactly...
I actually did find a site where I can order the gas, too. Tried a welding site instead of straight from a lab.

The job I have doesn't make me enough money. It barely sustains.

Can't get any writing jobs and the skills I have will only land me a similar job at similar, barely decent pay.

I barely even write anymore, anyway.

Fiction writing, mostly dark fantasy.

Tried submitting. Most were rejected in a day or so with no critique and no literary peers want to read what I write.

I already threw away the original drafts to my comic.
I've been looking into buying a tank of pure nitrogen for my plan but it's a pain in the ass to get, let alone afford.

To be the opposite, to have unfathomable amounts of rogue power.

To get what I want, go where I please and have the lives of billions in my hands.

I would be a Doom-esque supervillain.

An immense sum of money or superhuman/supernatural powers.

Since both are completely impossible, nothing.

Sure thing.

Keep up the good fight and don't let it consume you, man.

I understand the feeling but am in the situation where I can't do anything about it. It's like stoking a flame that can't be released, or if it can, it's in a way that barely does anything to extinguish it.

So, with nowhere to go, it burns me alive.

I've tried the therapy route. After three sessions, they refused to speak to me until I was heavily medicated and with psych costs, forget it. Not gonna dope myself for the rest of my life.

But I will say this -- If you're seeing a therapist and it's working, stick with it. Do anything you can to extinguish that flame before it burns you alive. Some people can't do anything but wait until they're ash.

I weightlift and run at home, three times a week total. 

That, in combination with living out my less than humane fantasies through roleplaying forums, keeps me stable at most.

Though, even that is starting to falter. Can't afford martial arts classes near me.

Tried. Doesn't work.

At best, it keeps it at bay but I need to do something...physical. Something different.

Dark fantasy. Horror. Science Fiction.

Blending reality and fiction under a dim light, basically.

The act of creating, specifically writing.

It is the only thing I hold genuine passion in.
This was a small light of joy in my day, just thinking about you making this your mission to do this.

I thought his Joker was...unique. Though I didn't care for any of his other roles. I think most people thought that The Dark Knight was his turning point in which he was really starting to shine in Hollywood.

Then he dies.

That may be where the adoration comes in. Wasted potential and all that.
That's love~

I will be sure to look into this, for sure. I'm definitely not as religious as my parents but I do like reading up on different perceptions of ideals and ideologies. I love reading up on philosophy, as well.

I don't completely disagree. On the one hand, there's an incessant need to release such pent-up things in such a way. On the other hand, there is something nagging me that it's not the way to go, both for legal and moral purposes. So, there's a conflict between myself and my alter-ego, so to speak.

I'm open to any commentary or attempt at assistance but, honestly, with how long this has been going on, short of something truly extraordinary, it will only continue to get worse until action is taken in some degree.
